description: Utility methods for marshmallow, including type checks, timestamp conversions, and object utilities.

methods.name: is_generator
methods.description: Return True if ``obj`` is a generator

methods.name: is_iterable_but_not_string
methods.description: Return True if ``obj`` is an iterable object that isn't a string.

methods.name: is_sequence_but_not_string
methods.description: Return True if ``obj`` is a sequence that isn't a string.

methods.name: is_collection
methods.description: Return True if ``obj`` is a collection type, e.g list, tuple, queryset.

methods.name: is_aware
methods.description: Check if a datetime object is timezone-aware.

methods.name: from_timestamp
methods.description: Convert a POSIX timestamp to a datetime object.

methods.name: from_timestamp_ms
methods.description: Convert a millisecond POSIX timestamp to a datetime object.

methods.name: timestamp
methods.description: Get the timestamp from a datetime object, ensuring timezone awareness.

methods.name: timestamp_ms
methods.description: Get the timestamp in milliseconds from a datetime object.

methods.name: ensure_text_type
methods.description: Convert bytes or str to a str type.

methods.name: pluck
methods.description: Extract a list of values for a given key from a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieve a value from an object or dict, supporting nested keys.

methods.name: _get_value_for_keys
methods.description: Helper for get_value, handling nested keys.

methods.name: _get_value_for_key
methods.description: Retrieve a single key's value from an object or dict.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Set a value in a nested dict using dot notation for the path.

methods.name: callable_or_raise
methods.description: Ensure an object is callable, else raise TypeError.

methods.name: timedelta_to_microseconds
methods.description: Calculate total microseconds in a timedelta.
